description: This file defines the InternalReporter class for internal reporting in the Playwright test framework. It manages reporting lifecycle events, attaches code snippets to errors, and wraps other reporter instances.

classes.name: InternalReporter
classes.description: Implements the ReporterV2 interface to handle internal reporting tasks within the test framework, orchestrating event forwarding, error enrichment, and code snippet attachment.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version identifier 'v2' indicating the reporter version.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Initializes reporter configuration, start times, and propagates the configuration to underlying reporters.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Marks the beginning of test suite execution.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of an individual test case.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Handles standard output stream during test execution.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Handles standard error stream during test execution.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: Processes a paused test, adding code snippets to errors if applicable.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test case, attaching code snippets to errors.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Finalizes reporting at the end of test execution, including timing info.

methods.name: onExit
methods.description: Performs cleanup or final actions upon exit.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Attaches code snippets and locations to errors for better debugging.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Marks the start of a test step.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Marks the end of a test step, attaching code snippets if necessary.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Determines if the reporter outputs directly to stdio.

methods.name: _addSnippetToTestErrors
methods.description: Attaches code snippets and location info to all errors in a test result.

methods.name: _addSnippetToStepError
methods.description: Attaches code snippet to a specific test step error, if available.

methods.name: export function addLocationAndSnippetToError(config: FullConfig, error: TestError, file?: string/ addLocationAndSnippetToError

ctags.name: addLocationAndSnippetToError
ctags.pattern: /^export function addLocationAndSnippetToError(config: FullConfig, error: TestError, file?: string/

ctags.name: codeFrame
ctags.pattern: /^    const codeFrame = codeFrameColumns(source, { start: location }, { highlightCode: true });$/
